## New

- WoW: Forever: added profession icons on the bag items your professions use. Off by default, in Items.
- Added `/spack perf` to measure what the pack costs.

## Changes

- Potion alert: with a display time set, bag updates no longer show it again or extend it.
- Movement alert, Potion alert and the cursor do less work.

## Fixes

- Potion alert: covers every combat potion, in both qualities.
- Micro menu skin: fixed a protected function error in combat with the size and spacing override on.
